title: Owner page for placement P2–P4 on the mini PC and across both bases
goal: The owner can run P2–P4 by pasting commands, as P1 on the Mac
acceptance: A page under docs/acceptance gives tested commands for P2 (mini PC, PowerShell), P3 (mini PC worker with Mac remote inference) and P4 (Mac unavailable, then back), each with an expected result
Every command is dry-run (plan, zero model calls) before the page is published
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-18: the plan doc has no commands for P3 and P4 and mixes the mini PC into the Mac block. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-22: added authenticated plan/run probes, join tests and the pasteable PowerShell page; the owner approved the required execution surface in chat.
